title: TruthFrame
description: truth.v0: where a SIMULATOR put its emitters at picture time t. A separate channel from picture.v0, which never carries truth (VIDENS_SPEC.md 5, 8.7): the engine must not see it, and a viewer draws it only for simulated runs, in a style reserved for it. UNSTABLE, like picture.v0.

run_id.description: The picture run this truth belongs to.

active.description: Transmitting at t. A silent emitter still has a true position.

entity_id.description: The picture entity the simulator or a scorer associated with this emitter, if one did. Videns never makes this association itself.
